choose.otherwise: AND create_time >= CURRENT_DATE AND create_time < DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS ( SELECT DATE(#{begin}) AS dt UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM date_range WHERE dt < DATE(#{end}) ) SELECT dr.dt AS date, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS total_amount FROM date_range dr LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.create_time >= dr.dt AND o.create_time < DATE_ADD(dr.dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND o.status = 4 GROUP BY dr.dt ORDER BY dr.dt

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS ( SELECT DATE(#{begin}) AS dt UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM date_range WHERE dt < DATE(#{end}) ) SELECT dr.dt AS date, ( select count(1) from orders o where o.create_time >= dr.dt and o.create_time < DATE_ADD(dr.dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) AS daily_new_orders, ( select count(1) from orders o where o.create_time >= dr.dt and o.create_time < DATE_ADD(dr.dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY) and o.status = 4 ) AS daily_effective_new_orders FROM date_range dr ORDER BY dr.dt

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS ( SELECT DATE(#{begin}) AS dt UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM date_range WHERE dt < DATE(#{end}) ) SELECT dr.dt AS date, ( select count(1) from user u where u.create_time >= dr.dt and u.create_time < DATE_ADD(dr.dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) AS daily_new_users, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user u WHERE u.create_time < DATE_ADD(dr.dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) AS cumulative_users FROM date_range dr ORDER BY dr.dt

select oi.name as name, sum(oi.number) as count from orders o join order_item oi on o.id = oi.order_id where o.create_time >= #{begin} and o.create_time < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) and o.status = 4 group by oi.name order by count desc limit 10
